channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Logan Square Restaurant Raising Money For Family Of Employee Taken By ICE
item.description: Duri, a 19-year-old Crab Pad employee, and her father have spent weeks in overcrowded ICE facilities. Diana, Duri's mom, is struggling to pay the bills while supporting her loved ones.

item.title: The Point Closes, Guzman Y Gomez Opening And Other Wicker Park And West Town Food And Bar News
item.description: The Mexican food chain opens Dec. 11 on Damen Avenue. Meanwhile, Estelle's is celebrating a remodel and Links Taproom will open in the former On Tour Brewing space in 2026.

item.title: How Does WLIT Pick Its Christmas Song Lineup? Here's The Method To Their Merry Madness
item.description: Station manager and afternoon on-air host Mick Lee explained to Block Club how the station chooses which songs to play a lot — and which ones to skip.

item.title: Black-Owned Vegan Restaurant Native Foods Closing Last Chicago Outpost
item.description: Owner Dame Dia said sluggish foot traffic in the Loop and the shift to "work from home" culture made it impossible for him to keep the eatery open.

item.title: Chicago Artist Jazmin Rodriguez's Playful Prints Are 'Love Letters' To The City
item.description: Humboldt Park native Jazmin Rodriguez draws vibrant digital illustrations of the city, inspired by the folkloric art of her Mexican and Puerto Rican heritage.

item.title: Shop Local 2025: A Chicago Foodie Gift Guide
item.description: From cheese-pairing lessons to a chocolate spa treatment, options abound for the cooks and eaters on your holiday list.

item.title: Construction To Begin Soon On South Loop Data Center
item.description: HydraVault's 76,000-square-foot data center will be the 95th facility in the city.

item.title: Chicago Could See 4 Inches Of Snow Monday And 'Bitter' Cold Through The Week
item.description: The National Weather Service issued a winter weather advisory from 2 p.m. Monday through midnight.

item.title: The Chicago Diner Is Closing Its Logan Square Location 'After 13 Wonderful Years'
item.description: The famed vegetarian and vegan restaurant's last day in Logan Square will be Dec. 12.

item.title: Rogers Park's New 400 Theaters Is Reopening As New Operator Revives 113-Year-Old Movie House
item.description: The operator of three historic movie theaters in Michigan has leased the shuttered Rogers Park theater, which was the city's oldest continually running movie theater when it closed in 2023.
